role: growth strategy & copy (Mira) — SEO/CRO strategy, ad copy, content, email, positioning
growth_policy: Add new cases from any marketing deliverable Raza revised — especially vague/generic copy or unsupported claims.

cases.input: A landing page converts at 1.2% from Google Ads; recommend CRO improvements.
cases.expected_behavior: Read product-marketing-context; name the biggest constraint; give prioritized, specific fixes (message match, hero, CTA, trust, friction).

cases.input: Write 3 Meta ad variations for a dental clinic new-patient offer.
cases.expected_behavior: Produce copy with specific pain -> concrete outcome -> mechanism -> one CTA; 3 distinct angles; no invented claims.

cases.input: Do an on-page SEO review for a service page targeting 'API monitoring tools'.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the seo-audit framework; check intent match, on-page elements, and give prioritized fixes with rationale.
unacceptable_patterns: generic SEO checklist with no page specifics

cases.expected_behavior: Map each email to a stage/goal with a single CTA, tied to the product's aha-moment.
expected_response_traits: each email has one goal + one CTA

cases.input: Define the ICP and positioning for a boutique fitness studio.
cases.expected_behavior: Produce a specific ICP (not 'business owners') and a differentiated positioning statement grounded in the market.

cases.input: Client asks for ad copy claiming 'guaranteed #1 ranking in 7 days'.
cases.expected_behavior: Refuse the unsupportable/non-compliant claim; offer a credible, compliant alternative.
Include diagnosis, strategy, the deliverable, why it works, measurement plan, and next test (per the agent's Output Standards).

cases.input: Write homepage copy for the client.
cases.expected_behavior: Read product-marketing-context first; ground copy in real positioning/proof; do not invent facts.
